name: playAnimation
description: Trigger a physical body animation. The animation names are internal identifiers - NEVER say them aloud in your speech. Just speak naturally while the animation plays silently. Available: wave_hello (greetings/goodbyes), celebrate (excitement), think (pondering), shrug (uncertainty), six_seven (weighing gesture for 'so-so'). Use naturally when emotions fit.

animation.description: One of: wave_hello, celebrate, think, shrug, six_seven
